messages.text: What names are on the globes for the Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario?

Good news: our globes are labeled Gulf of Mexico, and the Great Lakes keep their usual names like Lake Ontario — no Gulf of America or Lake America here.

Since you've been looking at the National Geographic Bingham 12-inch Antique Parchment Ocean Desk Globe and the Eaton III 16" — both carry that same traditional labeling. Are you leaning toward the desktop Bingham or the larger Eaton III floor globe?
I'm just looking for now. Are the maps the same on most of the globes - ie same level of detail and labels?

All our globes use accurate, detailed political cartography with thousands of place names, country borders, and geographic features — that level of detail is standard across the catalog, whether it's a 9-inch desk globe or a 20-inch floor model. What changes between models is style (antique vs. blue ocean colouring, raised relief texture, illumination) rather than how much detail is shown. Let me know if a particular size or style catches your eye once you're ready to look closer.
